capabilities: Display a collapsible legend of graph view color groups
Group legend entries into sections with regular expressions
Rename entries or exclude them from the legend
Highlight a group's nodes on hover or pinned click
Switch click action to filter the graph's search query
extras: Reads color groups through the graph view's internal state because no public API exists, so an Obsidian update could break it; the plugin hides itself if that state is unavailable. Available in English and Japanese.
problem: The graph view colors nodes by color groups but never labels which color corresponds to which group.
summary: A collapsible legend for the graph view that lists your color groups and lets you highlight or filter their nodes.
